spans.text: Three minutes later, location targeted by Sangvis artillery.
Bozhe moy...
Are you star-spangled T-Dolls all this prone to heroics?
Haha...
Probably. We're never known for our levelheadedness...
Ah, you're finally smiling, RO.
I thought you'd changed after joining the AR Team.
Well...
The AR Team has very different dynamics. It's easy to become affected without realizing it...
(Sighs) That's why it's a surprise you guys managed to survive this long...
Always doing such crazy things. I'm not just talking about AR-15... You...
You lot...can actually die, you know...
Carpe diem, I guess. We succeeded though, at least for this time.
Humph, just barely.
But you did manage to make yourself useful as a team leader.
(Sighs) You have no idea how troublesome our operation was...
Thank goodness Miss Persica's hacking program is working. The muzzle velocity of the last shot was indeed significantly weakened.
Thanks everyone. Sten and AAT, thank you for helping us in taking over all the bases surrounding the mortar.
Heheh. With that, The Jupiter mortar's power will be greatly impaired.
So Sangvis Ferri's new toy isn't invincible after all!
But...what about Makarov and the others?
They're hurt and pinned down, not to mention Dreamer's troops are still searching for them...
(Stands up) Let's meet up with them first, and I'll contact the commander.
Don't worry. Everyone will be fine.
Commander, this is RO635.
We have successfully neutralized Sangvis Ferri's mortar. It poses no more threat to us.
However, we might encounter Dreamer and her forces along our retreat route.
Please keep us safe, Commander. I'll see you back at Griffin Control.
